title: SyntheticBank
description: Synthetic intracardiac EGM bank (may include real-noise conditioning at the signal level). Schema version 1.1. Maps to an HDF5 file with bank-level root attrs plus a `traces/` group containing per-trace columns. 1.1 (from 1.0) added the optional `bank_id` stable-artifact identifier (egm-contracts v0.5.0, cross-artifact linkage).

schema_version.description: Schema version in X.Y form. X (major) bumps at release; Y (minor) bumps on every dev-time structural change. Consumers MUST refuse unknown major versions.

created_utc.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp captured at write time.

bank_id.description: Stable artifact ID for this bank, e.g. 'tbank_synthetic_courtemanche_v1_5_2026-06-25'. Optional for legacy banks written before egm-contracts v0.5.0; egm-data stamps it on every new bank (enforced at write time, not by this schema, per the cross-artifact-linkage 'optional-in-schema, required-on-write' decision). Added 1.1.

description.description: Free-text human-readable description of this bank's intent (e.g., 'hybrid_v1 — 100 sims, 20 traces/sim, SNR 10-25 dB').

fs_hz.description: Sampling rate in Hz. Phase 1 is 1000.0 to match IAFDB.

patch_size_mm.description: Tissue patch side length in mm (square patch). Phase 1 = 40 mm.

patch_dr_mm.description: Spatial discretization step in mm. Phase 1 = 0.25 mm.

ap_time_unit_ms.description: Mapping from simulator's non-dimensional time to ms (Aliev-Panfilov-specific; 0 for fully dimensional simulators).

fibrosis_strategy_name.description: Identifier for the fibrosis substrate generation strategy. Phase 1 = 'uniform_random'.

fibrosis_params.description: Parameters of the fibrosis strategy. Stored on HDF5 as a JSON-encoded string attr (`fibrosis_params_json`) since HDF5 attrs are flat. Schema models the decoded structure.

electrode_config.description: Electrode grid configuration (grid shape, spacing, height range). Stored on HDF5 as JSON in `electrode_config_json`.

mixer_config.description: Noise mixer configuration (target SNR range, band, on/off knob). Stored on HDF5 as JSON in `mixer_config_json`.

experiment_config.description: Top-level experiment knobs that drove this bank's generation. Stored on HDF5 as JSON in `experiment_config_json`.

noise_bank_source.description: Identifier of the IAFDB noise bank consumed by the mixer (e.g., 'iafdb_noise_v1.h5').

traces.description: Per-trace columns. Maps to the HDF5 `traces/` group. All columns have first dimension N (the trace count) and are aligned.

signal.description: (N, T) float32 — the bipolar EGM waveforms.

simulation_id.description: (N,) int64 — patient/simulation index (the patient-aware split unit).

pair_index.description: (N,) int64 — index of the bipolar electrode pair within the grid (0..n_pairs).

electrode_row.description: (N,) int64 — row index within the 5x5 grid this pair belongs to.

fibrosis_density.description: (N,) float64 — requested fibrosis density (continuous label, 0.0 == healthy).

fibrosis_density_realized.description: (N,) float64 — actual fraction of non-conductive nodes after the substrate draw (differs from requested due to grid-size discretization).

electrode_height_mm.description: (N,) float64 — height of this electrode pair above the tissue surface, in mm. Sampled uniformly per simulation from [0.2, 1.0] mm in Phase 1.

seed.description: (N,) int64 — RNG seed used for this simulation (reproducibility).

snr_db.description: (N,) float64 — target signal-to-noise ratio at which IAFDB noise was mixed in. NaN when mixer was off.

stim_edge.description: (N,) UTF-8 — stimulation edge for the planar wave that produced this trace. Phase 1 only models planar-wave stim from a tissue edge; Phase 2 introduces point-source / S1-S2 protocols that will need a richer 'stimulation' object (type discriminator + protocol-specific params). When that schema version lands, this field is replaced (not extended); see project/known_issues.md for the migration plan.

noise_record.description: (N,) UTF-8 — IAFDB record name that supplied the noise segment ('' when mixer was off).

noise_channel.description: (N,) UTF-8 — IAFDB channel name that supplied the noise segment ('' when mixer was off).
